scope: Narrow route split in reopen_declared_slot_owner_run_precommit: the native spread-profile file compare is skipped for m5_derived precommits, whose profile is the recorded derived edition bound in the pins. Source only; no tests run, no imports beyond py_compile of the postimage, no edits.
checks: The patch moves the three native-profile statements under `if body.get("source_kind") != "m5_derived":` and changes nothing else (4 added lines, 3 removed, one comment).

Order inside reopen_declared_slot_owner_run_precommit (postimage 4061 to 4089): stream and canonical-recheck the stored precommit, _validate_declared_precommit_body(context, body), config binding checks, then the profile block, then seal, register and verify_declared_slot_owner_run_precommit. So the validator runs before the skipped block.

_validate_declared_precommit_body for m5_derived: _validate_declared_m5_source_pins(pins, cell) must equal m5_view_contract_sha256, then _validate_declared_m5_profile_binding(pins, spread_profile_identity) requires spread_profile_identity == {profile_sha256} and profile_sha256 == pins.cost_edition_identity.profile_sha256. declared_slot_source_kind(body) runs inside it and refuses a legacy schema carrying source_kind and the clock kind (DECLARED_SLOT_M5_CONTROL_CLOCK_UNAVAILABLE), so by the time the raw source_kind key is tested it is absent or exactly m5_derived.

C6 consumption-time authentication exists in pm_m5_derived_costs.py: open_recorded_derived_costs(pins) checks the recorded profile digest against pins.profile_sha256 (COST_PROFILE_IDENTITY_MISMATCH, line 116), the policy (COST_PROFILE_POLICY_MISMATCH, 125) and the activation profile descriptor (150).
The native branch statements are byte-identical to closure004 inside the new guard.

The removed compare was not merely unreachable on the invented fixture: on real M5 the native file (b6) never equals the recorded derived edition (9fe), so every M5 cold reopen would have failed DECLARED_SLOT_PROFILE_BINDING_MISMATCH. The M5 cold reopen was a never-run positive path until the public metadata QA reached it, which is the class E4580 F1 asked the first integration QA nodes to cover.

closure004 differs from the Original review pin cc3020db only by adding pm_authority_spool.py and pm_authority_spool_quota.py to _DECLARED_M5_CONSTRUCTORS; _declared_m5_constructor_identity resolves each name with Path(__file__).with_name, so the flat-installation condition before any issuer stands.

findings.text: issue_declared_slot_source_access_renewal (postimage 3372) keeps the identical unconditional native profile load compared against parent["spread_profile_identity"]. Its parent comes from _declared_renewal_parent, which reopens and verifies the precommit, so the same two-line guard applies. Without it any M5 source-access renewal fails with the misleading profile-mismatch code. Not blocking for a development run that finishes inside its access window; blocking before any M5 run that can outlive it.
declared_slot_source_kind(body) in place of body.get("source_kind") would state the dependency the comment relies on; equivalent today because the validator ran first.
